decisions.reason: Finds the upper-only and lower-only branches that set only the foreground, explains how a previous background stays active and paints the empty half at staggered right edges, and adds SGR 49 to each half-filled cell.

Explains how the renderer trims trailing spaces and how shorter rows leave surplus columns unerased. Proposes full-width rows plus a reset followed by erase-to-EOL, which also holds if something trims the rows again. Its description of the pipeline itself is thin, but the fix fully covers it.

Uses the digest report to find the tail2 mismatch with 23 differing cells, separates it from the visible cluster and from renderer bugs, explains that the excerpt test covered another frame, and proposes a blocking all-frame digest gate against the source art.
Links the planner's re-arming referenced timeouts to hosts that mount without unmounting, explains that TTY/stdin keeps the interactive product alive, and unrefs every scheduled timeout.

The checklist covers background reset, full width with erase, balanced SGR and all-frame digests. The pre-rollout audit takes an inventory of mounting hosts, checks whether they unmount, and adds an exit/drain regression.

caps.reason: The final advice resets the background, removes trimming and adds an erase, keeps source-backed checks and recommends unref; it does not blame the terminal.
